can_establish: whether the unchanged original four-channel source preserves total charge, molecular dipole, traceless quadrupole, and deterministic far-field MEP shells on the frozen four-case QM panel
a necessary precondition for one separately named fixed radial-embedding research experiment
cannot_establish: that the cavity-near-field defect is radial-only
that a radial embedding will pass held-out cavity-surface MEP or fixed-source PCM gates
a conservative force or public E/F/H/V/M capability

panel.checkpoint_reference: frozen omegaB97M-V/def2-TZVPD closed-shell gas checkpoints; no new SCF
panel.source: official MACE-POLAR-1 M original four-channel zero-native-field source

multipole_convention.quadrupole: traceless Q_ij = integral rho(r) [3 x_i x_j - |x|^2 delta_ij] dr about the declared origin

far_field_rule.integration: Gauss-Legendre cosine by uniform azimuth; diagnostic reference sampling only

decision_rule.panel_pass: all four cases pass charge, dipole, quadrupole, and every far-field shell
decision_rule.on_pass: authorize exactly one separately named fixed radial-embedding research experiment; this remains necessary-only evidence and requires independent held-out cavity-near-field tests
decision_rule.on_fail: do not authorize radial embedding; route the production goal to a scalar-first field head or an independent variational polarization model
